Output.Description: Edit all settings for your output configuration in this dialog.

Source.Title: Source value
Source.Description: Configure the value for this output configuration.
Source.Label: Source

SourceType.Title: Step 1 - Select source type
SourceType.Description: Select where the value comes from.

DeviceType.Title: Step 1 - Display type
DeviceType.Description: Select the type of device you want to configure.

Device.Title: Output device
Device.Description: Configure the settings for this output device configuration.

TestPanel.Title: Step - Test output device
TestPanel.Description: Test the functionality of this output device configuration.

Stepper.Title: Step 2 - Stepper settings
Stepper.Description: Select the stepper and configure how values map to its movement.
Stepper.Label: Stepper

Calibrate.Title: Step 3 - Calibrate stepper
Calibrate.Description: Use the jog buttons to adjust the stepper position and set home position.
Calibrate.Hint: Use the arrow keys to select the step size. Use space to move the stepper. Use enter to set the home position.

Servo.Title: Step 2 - Servo settings
Servo.Description: Select the servo and map the value range to its rotation.
Servo.Label: Servo

Output.Title: Step 2 - Output settings
Output.Description: Select one or more pins and configure the brightness.
Output.Label: Output
Output.DynamicBrightnessDescription: Dynamic brightness is controlled by current value ($)
Output.StaticBrightnessDescription: Set the static brightness for all values other than 0.

ShiftRegister.Title: Step 2 - Output shift register settings
ShiftRegister.Description: Select the shift register and one or more of its outputs.
ShiftRegister.Label: Output Shift Register

SevenSegment.Title: Step 2 - 7-Segment settings
SevenSegment.Description: Select the module and configure which digits show the value.
SevenSegment.Label: 7-Segment

AdvancedOptions.Title: Advanced options
AdvancedOptions.Description: Configure advanced display options for the 7-segment module.

Brightness.Label: Brightness
Brightness.Description: Use the value of another output config to set the brightness of the display.

LcdDisplay.Title: Step 2 - LCD Display settings
LcdDisplay.Description: Select the LCD display and configure its settings.
LcdDisplay.Label: LCD Display

CustomDevice.Title: Step 2 - Custom Device settings
CustomDevice.Description: Select the device and the message that receives the value.
CustomDevice.Label: Custom Device

Modifiers.Title: Modifiers
Modifiers.Label: Modifiers
Modifiers.Description: Change the original value by applying a sequence of modifiers.

Transformation.Label: Transformation
Transformation.Description: Apply a transformation to the input value using the specified expression.

Substring.Label: Substring
Substring.Description: Extract a substring from the input value using the specified start and end position.

Padding.Label: Padding
Padding.Description: Adjust the padding of the input value using the specified length, character, and direction.

Interpolation.Label: Interpolation
Interpolation.Description: Define mappings between input and output values. Values outside the range are clamped.

Comparison.Label: Comparison
Comparison.Description: Compare the current value with another value and adjust the output if it matches or not.

Blink.Label: Blink
Blink.Description: Alternates the original input value with the Off value using the sequence below.

Editor.Title: Edit modifiers
Editor.Description: Add, configure, rearrange, and remove modifiers to change the original input value.

TestPanel.Title: Test modifiers
TestPanel.Description: Test the functionality of the configured modifiers.

Preconditions.Title: Preconditions
Preconditions.Label: Preconditions
Preconditions.Description: Add and modify conditions that must be met so that your trigger will be executed.

ConfigReferences.Title: References
ConfigReferences.Label: References
ConfigReferences.Description: Add references to other configs and use their values here in this config.

PreconditionEditor.Title: Edit preconditions
PreconditionEditor.Description: Add and modify conditions that must be met so that action can be executed.

ConfigReferenceEditor.Title: Edit references
ConfigReferenceEditor.Description: Add and modify references and define a placeholder to use the values in your config.

Input.Description: Edit all settings for this input configuration in this dialog.

ConfigTrigger.Title: Trigger
ConfigTrigger.Description: The trigger defines the conditions or events that will activate this configuration.

Action.Title: Actions
Action.Description: Define the actions for each event.
Action.NoTriggerDefined: No trigger defined. Please select your controller and device.

ActionType.Title: Step 1 - Action Type
ActionType.Description: Select the type of action you want to perform

onPress.label: On Press
onPress.description: The action will be executed once when the button is pressed.

onRelease.label: On Release
onRelease.description: The action will be executed once when the button is released.

onHold.label: On Hold
onHold.description: This action is triggered when the button is held down for a certain duration and can repeat at the specified interval.

holdDelay.label: Hold delay (ms)
holdDelay.description: The duration in milliseconds that the button must be held down before the action is triggered.

repeatDelay.label: Repeat delay (ms)
repeatDelay.description: The interval in milliseconds at which the action will be re-triggered while the button is held down. Set to 0 to disable repeating.

onLongRelease.label: On Long Release
onLongRelease.description: The action will be executed once when the button is released after being held down for the specified duration.

longReleaseDelay.label: Long release delay (ms)
longReleaseDelay.description: The duration in milliseconds that the button must be held down before a release will trigger this action.

onLeft.label: On Left
onLeft.description: The action will be executed once when the encoder is turned left.

onRight.label: On Right
onRight.description: The action will be executed once when the encoder is turned right.

onLeftFast.label: On Left Fast
onLeftFast.description: The action will be executed once when the encoder is turned left quickly.

onRightFast.label: On Right Fast
onRightFast.description: The action will be executed once when the encoder is turned right quickly.

onChange.label: On Change
onChange.description: The action will be executed once the value of the input changes.

Common.SupportedPlaceholders: Supports input value (@) and placeholders ($, #, etc.)

Preset.Label: Preset
Preset.Title: Step 2 - Select preset
Preset.Description: Choose a preset from our preset library. Use filters to narrow down your search.
Preset.Author: Author

Code.Title: Step 3 - Customize preset (optional)
Code.Description: This preset code is used with your simulator. You can edit it manually or choose a preset from the list above.
Code.Customized: You customized this preset or it is no longer available.

Xplane.PathPlaceholder: Enter path for DataRef or Command, or select a preset above
Xplane.PathDescription: Hint: Use index notation for access of Arrays, e.g. sim/cockpit2/annunciators/fuel_pressure_low[0] for 1st engine.

Preset.Title: Step 2 - ProSim Input Action
Preset.Description: Select a preset to configure your input actions.

VJoy.Title: Step 2 - Configure vJoy
VJoy.Description: Define the vJoy button or axis that you want to use.

Keyboard.Title: Step 2 - Configure Keyboard Input
Keyboard.Description: Define the keyboard key combination that you want to use.

FsuipcOffset.Title: Step 2 - Configure FSUIPC Offset
FsuipcOffset.Description: Define the FSUIPC offset that you want to use.

LuaMacro.Title: Step 2 - Lua Macro Input Action
LuaMacro.Description: Invoke your Lua macro with an optional parameter. Requires an existing Lua macro in FSUIPC.

Jeehell.Title: Step 2 - Configure Jeehell
Jeehell.Description: Define the Jeehell function that you want to use. You can either create a new one or use an existing function.

EventId.Title: Step 2 - Define Event ID
EventId.Description: Define the Event ID that you want to use. You can either create a new one or use an existing Event ID.

Retrigger.Title: Retrigger
Retrigger.Description1: Use this input action to re-trigger all button states.
Retrigger.Description2: This is helpful to sync your virtual cockpit to the switch and button states of your physical controllers.

Variable.Title: Step 2 - Configure Variable
Variable.Description: Define the variable that you want to use. You can either create a new one or use an existing variable.
Variable.ExpressionHelp: Use <1>$</1> to represent the variable value in expressions, e.g. <3>$ * 2</3> to double a number variable.
